item.description: We're seeing 200% of our usual data traffic—and climbing! Thanks to all of you for making this a night to remember

Bluesky’s Election Day feed features 700+ local reporters and newsrooms covering all 50 states and DC, many of them independent or nonprofit.
Want to keep up with their reporting today and year-round? Follow this battleground Starter Pack or any of the regional packs in the thread below. 🧵

New in beta: the moderation inbox.
Now you can see the reports you've made, and find out what happened to the content you reported, right in the Bluesky app. Notices about your account and appeals live there too.

v1.137 is live!
Now you can add a widget to your home screen that shows what’s trending on Bluesky.
We also squashed some bugs and made a few performance improvements.
getting our Halloween decorations set up

Also new in today’s v1.136 update: iPad support!
One of our most-requested features is finally here in beta.
Try out the Bluesky app on your iPad, and if you see anything off, let us know under Settings > Beta features.

v1.136 is live!
Introducing: Profile links
We want independent writers, artists, developers, and creators to be able to build and fund sustainable projects on Bluesky.
Help your followers know how to support you by adding buttons for Patreon, Ko-fi, your newsletter or website, and more.

STREAMING LIVE NOW: https://stream.place/niedermeyer.online
